$comment: Copy this file to industries/<id>.json and fill it in. Read docs/adding-an-industry.md first. The validator will reject an id that does not match the filename.
statusNote: draft until it has run two sweeps and someone has cut the qualifier list against real hits. Values: draft, unvalidated, proven, retired.

directSites.note: The buyers whose RFPs never reach a portal. For most industries this is where the real yield is, so do not leave it empty because portals are easier.

thresholds.note: The value below which a buyer in this industry may award without posting. Anything under it will never be found by a portal sweep, whatever the keywords.
